findings.entity: Chimera distributor tier: GsmEasy (imei.us) / GsmServer / Unlock.eu - fixed reseller price $0.092 per credit (non-discriminating)
findings.chain_layer: Original Developer (ChimeraTool) -> Distributor (GsmEasy | GsmServer | Unlock.eu) -> HalabTech (reseller, 20k-credit tier) -> Customer
skus_affected: Chimera Tool Credits [NOT FOR WEB OWNER]
Chimera Tool Basic (100 Device - 1 Year) [NOT FOR WEB OWNER]
Chimera Tool Professional (Username/Dongle) (1500 Devices - 1 Year) [NOT FOR WEB OWNER]
Chimera Tool Premium (Username/Dongle) (5000 Devices - 1 Year) [NOT FOR WEB OWNER]
findings.claim: Costing Chimera's credit-denominated licences (999/1,499/1,899 CRD) at the live distributor reseller price of $0.092/credit gives $91.91/$137.91/$174.71, which HalabTech sells at $99.99/$149/$189 - a consistent x1.080-1.088 across three SKUs (credits $0.11 = x1.196); Pro/Premium are below GsmServer retail ($149.90/$189.90), so HalabTech must hold reseller-tier credits.
findings.excerpt: Chimera Tool Reseller Credits ... 0.0920
findings.alternative_explanations: Chimera fixes the reseller discount for every distributor ('Resellers can buy credits from our distributors at a fixed 8% discount rate compared to end-user prices'), so GsmEasy (0.0920), Unlock.eu (20,000 CRD/$1,840) and GsmServer (non-public, same rule) all yield the identical $0.092 cost - the match is vendor-imposed and cannot discriminate between them. HalabTech could also buy credits from another 20k-tier reseller at <= end-user price, but Pro/Premium would then be sold at a loss.
findings.contradicting_evidence: Basic ($99.99) is $0.09 above Chimera list ($99.9) while Pro/Premium are 0.6%/0.5% below list - within Chimera's 3% reseller-discount band (floor $96.90/$145.40/$184.20 as priced by GsmEasy/Unlock.eu). GsmServer publishes no 20k reseller pack (only USD 0.10, min 10 credits) so its reseller price is inferred from the vendor rule, not observed.
findings.what_would_confirm: A HalabTech/Chimera/distributor statement naming HalabTech's credit source; Chimera reseller directory or distributor page listing HalabTech as its sub-reseller; HalabTech Telegram posts about 20k-credit purchases from a named distributor.
findings.what_would_reject: Evidence that HalabTech's Chimera SKUs are API-forwarded to another reseller at end-user price, or that HalabTech lost reseller status (no 20k purchase per 4 months).
findings.supports_or_contradicts: Supports A1-21, C-01, C-02, C-03, C-06, V-03 (distributor-only rule) and extends 'Chimera -> GsmEasy OR GsmServer -> HalabTech' with Unlock.eu as a third, price-identical reseller-pack seller.
findings.notes: Live GsmEasy licence prices: Pro USD145.40, Basic USD96.90, Premium USD184.50 (=0.97 x list, the maximum reseller discount). GsmServer live: credits USD 0.10, Basic 99.90, Pro 149.90, Premium 189.90 (snippets), Pro dongle 174.80, Premium dongle 214.80.
